verses.1: And after these things, God tested Abraham. He said to him, “Abram,” and Abraham replied, “Here I am.”
verses.2: And he said, “Please take your son, your only child whom you loved—Isaac. Go to the land of Moriah, and bring him up there, onto one of the mountains that I have told you about.”
verses.3: In the morning, Abraham gathered his livestock. He took two of his sons with him, along with Isaac, his son. Then he cut down some trees and set out on his journey to the place where God had told him to go.
verses.4: On the third day, Abraham raised his eyes and saw the place from afar.
verses.5: And Abraham said to his sons, “Go back with the sheep. I and the sons will go there and worship them, and then we will return to you.”
verses.6: And Abraham took the branches of the tree, and placed them on his son Isaac. He also took fire and food with him. And they went together.
verses.7: And Isaac said to his father Abraham, “My father,” and he replied, “I am your son.” Then he said, “Look! There’s fire and wood. But where is the firewood for the fire?”
verses.8: And Abraham said, “May God have mercy on him. May he go up to heaven.” And they went together.
verses.9: And they went to the place where God had told them to build. There, Abraham built the altar. He also cut down the trees and set Isaac on the altar, above the trees.
verses.10: And Abraham stretched out his hand and took the food to slaughter his son.
verses.11: And the angel of the LORD called to him from heaven. And Abraham replied, “Here I am.”
verses.12: And he said, “Do not send your hand to the boy, and do not do him any harm. For now I know that you fear God. You have not harmed your only son from me.”
verses.13: And Abraham raised his eyes and saw that there was a bird with its beak held out. Then Abraham took the bird and carried it up into the sky.
verses.14: And Abraham called out the name of that place: “Yehova.” It means “Yahweh will see.” This name is mentioned today in the words, “On the mountain of Yehova, He will be seen.”
verses.15: And the LORD’s angel called out to Abraham once again from heaven.
verses.16: And he said, “Blessed be you, O LORD! For you have done this thing, and you have not abandoned your beloved one.”
verses.17: For I bless you, and I multiply your seed as the stars in the sky and the sun that rises on the sea. May he inherit your seed and rule over his enemies.
verses.18: And all the nations of the earth shall be blessed through your seed, because of what you have heard in my mouth.
verses.19: And Abraham sat down with his sons. They got up and went together to the place called Beersheba. Then Abraham stayed in Beersheba.
verses.20: And after these things, he told Abraham, “Look! She also will have children, just like your brother Nahor.”
verses.21: His sons, his brothers, and Kemuel, my father’s son.
verses.22: And the thigh, and the hip, and the pelvis, and the knee, and the leg.
verses.23: And in Betuel, Rebekah was born. She became the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.24: And Pilagsho, whose name was Ruma, also gave birth to Tevach and Gacham, as well as Tahash and Ma’akha.
